note: Both sets capture the core facts (400 g total actuation force, 2900 g heated austenite pull force, 10 g max pull per louver, 200C-to-cryogenic transformation range, 15-20C austenite range) with supporting quotes. Set A, however, contains two redundant duplicate claims (the 400 g total actuation force and the 2900 g pull force each appear twice under slightly different entity labels) and omits the 2500 gram pull force during the cool martensite phase. Set B has no duplicates and includes that missing 2500 gram martensite-phase value, so it is more complete and equally accurate.
